title: Deformations of the $\mathfrak{osp}(n|2)$-action on the superspace of symbols of differential operators on $\R^{1|n}$
summary: We study formal deformations of the natural $\osp(n|2)$-action, $n\geq 3$, on the superspace $\Sc^n_d=\bigoplus_{k\geq 0}\Fc^n_{d-\frac{k}{2}}$ of symbols of linear differential operators on weighted densities over $\R^{1|n}$. Starting from the first cohomology space computed in \cite{10}, we compute the cup-product $\Hd^1\vee \Hd^1\to \Hd^2$ which carries the quadratic obstructions. The answer is governed by the $\osp(n|2)$-invariant operators $A_k=η_1\cdotsη_n\partial_x^{k-1}$: the two cocycles $h_k$ and $\widetilde{h}_k$ spanning the off-diagonal part of $\Hd^1$ are exactly the two…
